description: Claim classification and evidence scoring. Classifies text claims as BLOCKED/ALLOWED_BOUNDED/UNKNOWN using regex pattern matching. Computes weighted evidence score with fail-closed penalties across six dimensions. Includes proof firewall and maturity stage tracking.
function: Claim classification (BLOCKED/ALLOWED_BOUNDED/UNKNOWN), evidence scoring, proof firewall, maturity map

inputs.name: inp
inputs.description: Evidence dimension scores and flags for compute_evidence_score

inputs.name: expected
inputs.description: Expected number of raw outputs for from_gate_counts

inputs.name: scoring
inputs.description: Whether scoring has been executed (default False)

inputs.name: independence
inputs.description: Whether independent review has occurred (default False)

inputs.name: strong_public_claim
inputs.description: Whether a strong public claim is being made (default False)

inputs.name: flags
inputs.description: Stage flags for maturity_map (idea, design, prototype, raw, scoring, replay, review, deploy)
